notes.title: Small service update
Big January update
notes.content:
Here we come to the first quarterly big update. As we said before, the game now features the first few levels and the beginning of the story. You can safely begin to go through the storyline, the save should not break with the release of new versions of the game. What exactly we did in this update:
[list]
[*] The demo level has been replaced with story levels of the game (at the moment there are 4 first levels).
[*] The algorithm for using items from the inventory on the environment has been changed - now when you interact with the environment, items from your inventory are used automatically as needed.
[*] Added the ability to rotate the camera, as well as zoom in and out.
[*] Improved adaptation of the interface for screens with non-standard aspect ratio.
[*] Added the ability to save on levels. Saving occurs automatically in key locations.
[*] Now the player can equip several similar weapons at once in different slots.
[*] Fixed a bug when, when changing the graphics quality settings from a low level even lower, the settings value took on a non-existent value.
[*] Fixed head shaking on dead characters.
[*] And also many other small errors and shortcomings are fixed.
[/list]

With each subsequent quarterly update, we will add new levels, weapons and enemies, as well as once or twice a month we will continue to release small updates that fix bugs and, if possible, add something new.

notes.title: What's will be in the January update
notes.content:
It's time for the New Year holidays and before we leave to gain strength to continue our current projects and launch new ones, we would like to tell you about what will be in the January Tower update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39063981/8efa8cc6943eb3cf21bc005e3b58e8cadf59ad29.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b] The main [/b] is the replacement of the demo level with the first game levels. If you have already purchased the game, then you can finally start your adventure and continue it as we add new levels.
[*] We take into account the wishes of the players, and in this update it becomes possible to rotate and zoom the camera.
[*] We also changed the algorithm for interacting with closed doors - now to use the key card there is no need to open the inventory.
[/list]

We are still working on this big January update and are trying to add as much new as possible to it. We will announce the exact date of the update after the holidays. And now we want to wish everyone a Happy New Year and Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Xmas update
notes.content:
Ho-ho-ho! Christmas is coming! While our elves are working on the big update coming in January, we have a little Christmas mood for you. All participants in the events taking place on the unknown floor of Tower INC are getting ready for the Christmas party and are waiting for you to bring them gifts in lead packaging!

We did not waste time in vain and caught several malicious bugs: now the player will not run on the spot when only pressing the run key, and will also be able to hold the revolver correctly in his hands.

We wish you all a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: First update
notes.content: To brighten up the anticipation of the big January update, we have released a small update that will give you a reason to go through the demo level again. This time, a new weapon is hidden in the back streets of the offices of an unknown floor - pistols, which will give you an undeniable advantage over the invaders. In addition, we added special effects of blood splashes on the walls and made it possible to reconfigure the game control for yourself. And also corrected the sounds of the speech of terrorists, so that they no longer scream louder than other sounds of the environment.
